name: gobind-catering-backend
description: Backend API and PDF generation engine for Gobind Catering

scripts.check-template: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'fs'; const p='src/templates/Gobind Catering Menu Card (1).pdf'; if (!fs.existsSync(p)) { console.error('Missing '+p); process.exit(1); } console.log('Template present: '+p);"
